observations: A white game console is shown standing vertically, featuring a distinct horizontal slit across the side plates.
The PlayStation 'PS' logo is visible on the upper left plate.
A white DualSense controller is positioned in front of the console.
The console appears to be the 'Slim' revision of the PlayStation 5 based on the plate design.
The right side of the console (bottom when vertical) appears flat, suggesting it is the Digital Edition or the disc drive is not attached.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI IKT GADGETS HUB' overlaid on the image.
No cables, power cords, or the vertical stand are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: There is no photo of the console powered on or connected to a display.
The horizontal slit across the side plates in photo 0 is the defining visual feature of the PS5 Slim model.
One DualSense controller is visible in photo 0.
No accessories such as HDMI, power, or charging cables are shown.

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on and running a game.
Photo of the side of the console to confirm if it has a disc drive.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PlayStation 5 Slim. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional Digital Edition) until proof of operation and the presence of a disc drive are provided.
